script.title: Godman Protocols — All 7 Working Together
script.description: 90-second integration demo: SOUL → PACT → AMF → SIGNAL → SCORE → LAX → DRS in a real multi-agent workflow

scenes.caption: 7 protocols that agents have been missing
SOUL: Every agent system needs constitutional rules
PACT: Bounded authority instead of unlimited trust
Creates, signs, and verifies in 3 lines
AMF: Structured, verifiable inter-agent messages
Every message has a hash. Tampering is detectable.
SIGNAL: Observable async coordination between agents
SCORE: Objective agent evaluation with audit trail
LAX: Route tasks to fastest slot within token budget
SLA enforcement built in — no surprises at billing
DRS: Preemptible resource allocation with expiry
Prevents resource starvation in multi-agent systems

scenes.text:
✅ All 7 protocols. One workflow. Zero trust.

   npm install @godman-protocols/{pact,soul,amf,signal,score,lax,drs}
   github.com/skingem1/godman-protocols
   Launching April 14, 2026
scenes.caption: Ship sovereign multi-agent infrastructure today
